outcome_summary: All six targeted changes across the Application Framework and HCP Editor were implemented successfully. The security gap where `SetMailingStateAPI::handleFinalize()` lacked a Tier 2 rights check is closed, the test infrastructure for API key methods is improved with a convenience factory, and several smaller code quality improvements (log enrichment, dead cache fix, UI template completeness, test fixture cleanup) are in place.
project_summary: This project closes remaining gaps from the API Method Rights Enforcement initiative in the Application Framework. It fixes a security hole where SetMailingStateAPI::handleFinalize() bypassed the Tier 2 finalize-mails rights check, and adds a convenience test helper to eliminate boilerplate in API key method tests. Additional improvements include enriched authorization denial log messages, HTTP 403 documentation in the API UI template, a dead cache write-path fix in Application::createUser(), and test fixture cleanup.
